## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The code change works, but the README still documents the old 30-second default, so users are told the wrong timeout; that stale line needs fixing.

## Changes
This pull request changes `DEFAULT_TIMEOUT` in `app/cli.py` from 30 to 60 seconds and updates `test_defaults` to expect 60. It also adds a one-line `review.txt` file at the repository root.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- app/cli.py:3 — comments — Update the README's default timeout to 60 seconds — Your change sets `DEFAULT_TIMEOUT = 60`, but `README.md:3` still says "Requests time out after 30 seconds unless you pass `--timeout SECONDS`." That sentence is now false for every run without `--timeout`. — Users and operators who rely on the README will expect a 30-second timeout when requests actually wait up to 60 seconds. — Fix: Change `README.md:3` to say 60 seconds.
